description: Neutral case with vanishing sensible heat flux. No predefined hmix provided — PBL height falls back to default (800m) because GPU PBL path does not yet implement bulk Richardson from profile points. u* derived from surface stress.

oracle_reference_values.note: These values are derived from the GPU PBL diagnostics path (pbl_diagnostics.wgsl) which implements the same physics as FLEXPART 11.1 calcpar.f90. The profile point is not yet used in the GPU path (TODO in shader), so hmix falls back to 800m.

ctl.description: Inverse Obukhov length 1/L = 0.0 (neutral). Bulk Richardson from profile would be 0.0625 < 0.25 → Neutral, but GPU path uses fallback hmix.

computed_by: GPU PBL diagnostics (pbl_diagnostics.wgsl, matching FLEXPART 11.1 calcpar.f90 physics)

reproduction.note: Run this integration test. The GPU path computes u* from surface stress (0.3 N/m²) and rho (~1.14 kg/m³ at 298K, 101325 Pa) → u* = sqrt(0.3/1.14) ≈ 0.513, clamped to ustar_min → ~0.5. With H=0, 1/L=0, hmix falls back to 800m.
